text: Visuals were too static/same; add more elements and make characters expressive
Text went out of frame; animations did not match the script; placement should be symmetrical
Audio events did not match visuals (everything must be cued to the spoken word)
When names are spoken all characters must be visible in the same frame with names
No single frame for 12 s; use many frames (shots of 3-4 s) but learn the reference cinematics
Bull (Dharma) looks like a blob; needs real anatomy, horns, hump, legs, animation
Kamadeva birth: heart icon covers his face
Eight mountains rise shot starts sparse; stagger peaks earlier
Tower of realms is flat colored bands; needs painted skies/underworld detail

Character design rules (owner): (1) identity cues must be instantly readable (e.g. Shiva: tiger-skin wrap, third eye, tripundra, crescent moon ONLY on hair, serpent, trident+damaru). (2) Anger must come from eyes+brows+mouth only: glowing RED eyes, heavy lowered brows, plain frown the SAME width as the smile. NO fangs, NO open screaming mouth, NO face lines/creases/cheek hollows (they read as monkey). (3) Hair in anger stays natural, no antler/flying ropes. (4) No extra ornaments the owner did not ask for (Ganga ribbon removed). (5) Costume must cover the body in every pose (skirt widens with leg spread). (6) Cinematic muted palette, light rim, grain, vignette like the reference video. (7) Final length of every video: 8-10 min.

Character PROPORTION rule (owner): all characters must look like proper adult heroic figures, about 7 heads tall, smaller head, long torso and legs. NO bobble-head, NO chibi, NO kid versions. Gemini prompts must always say '7 heads tall, heroic proportions, NOT chibi'. Style = simple geometric flat vector with round joint discs; characters must stay fully animatable.
